top_signals.title: Big bets against AI debt, from CoreWeave to Oracle and the Mag 7, could soon hit the ETF market
top_signals.summary: Investor fears about AI balance sheets and debt are running high, especially for neoclouds. ETFs targeting the credit default swaps of AI issuers are coming.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: US surges power projection to westernmost island chain as Russia, China loom
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Air Force is expanding its training on America's westernmost islands, where it can project power and monitor adversaries across the Pacific and the Arctic.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Retail dealmaking returns as Asda eyes takeover targets
top_signals.summary: Dealmaking within the UK’s hugely competitive retail sector is back on the agenda, as high street businesses vie to coax cash out of shoppers’ increasingly tight wallets.  Rising business costs, shaky consumer confidence and a less aggressive competition watchdog mean retailers are now looking again at the prospect of consolidation, analysts and advisors told City [...]
